a: Shehushevu maasim lemaasim?!
Vaata leh par yom hakkippurim (name) leet bedam utevila mippar kohen mashiach; veate leh seir yom hakkippurim misseire avoda zara – mikkal vachomer.
Vechi davar hallamed behekkesh, chozer umelammed bekal vachomer?! amar rav pappa: kasavar tana deve rabbi yishmael: davar hallamed behekkesh, chozer umelammed bekal vachomer.
"Lappar" – ze par helem davar shel tzibbur. ha betzibbur gufeh ketiv! amar rav pappa: mishshum devae agmore par helem davar shel tzibbur beyoteret ushete kelayot, lisire avoda zara.
Ufar helem davar shel tzibbur – begufeh la ketiv, behekkesha ate; itzterich "lappar" –
Lemihve keman dichtiv beh begufeh, vela leheve davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh.
Tanya kevavteh derav pappa: "veasa kaasher asa" – ma talmud lomar "lappar"?

Lefi shenneemar: "vehem heviu et korbanam ishshe laAdonai vegomer"; "chattatam" – ellu seire avoda zara, "shiggatam" – ze par helem davar shel tzibbur, "chattatam al shiggatam" – amra tora: chattatam hare hi lach keshiggatam;
Shiggatam mehechan lamadta – lo behekkesh? vechi davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh?!
Talmud lomar: "lappar" – ze par helem davar shel tzibbur, "lefar" – ze par kohen mashiach.

Amar mar: "chattatam" – ellu seire avoda zara. tippok leh mikkera kamma, deamar mar: "hachattat" – lerabbot seire avoda zara! amar rav pappa: itzterich; salka datach amena: hane mille hazzaot – dichtivan begufeh,
b: Aval yoteret ushete chelayot – dela ketivan begufeh, ema la; ka mashma lan.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa: veha tanna – par yom hakkippurim lechol ma sheamar beinyan kaamar! tannae hi; tanna deve rav merabbe hachi, tanna deve rabbi yishmael la merabbe hachi.

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: mippene ma neemru yoteret ushete chelayot befar kohen mashiach, velo neemru befar helem davar shel tzibbur? mashal lemelech basar vadam shezzaam al ohavo, umiet besirchono mippene chibbato.

Vetana deve rabbi yishmael: mippene ma neemra "parochet hakkodesh" befar kohen mashiach, velo neemar befar helem davar shel tzibbur? mashal lemelech basar vadam shessarcha alav medina; im miutah sarcha – pamalya shello mitkayyemet, im rubbah sarcha – en pamalya shello mitkayyemet.
Lefichach im natan kullan ketiknan kulei. tenan hatam: piggel bakkometz velo ballevona; ballevona velo bakkometz – rabbi meir omer: piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.
Vachachamim omrim: en bo karet ad sheyyefaggel bechol hammattir.

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: la tema tama derabbi meir, dekasavar mefaggelin bachatzi mattir; ella hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennatan et hakkometz bemachshava, vehallevona bishtika; kasavar: kol haose – al daat rishona hu ose.
Mimmay? middekatane: lefichach im natan kullan ketiknan veachat shello ketiknah – pasul veen bo karet. ha achat shello ketiknah vechullan ketiknan – piggul;
Manni? illema rabbanan – ha amri rabbanan: en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir! ella rabbi meir.
Vei tama derabbi meir mishshum dimfaggelin bachatzi mattir hu – afillu kidkatane name! lav mishshum dekasavar: kol haose – al daat rishona hu ose?
Amar rabbi shemuel bar yitzchak: leolam rabbanan hi; umay ketiknan – ketiknan lefiggul.
Veha middekatane: lefichach im natan kullan ketiknan veachat shello ketiknan – pasul veen bo karet; mikkelal detiknah – lehechshera hu daata!
Amar rava: may shello ketiknah – chutz limkomo. rav ashe amar: shello lishmo.
Mikkelal dechi la aved la chutz limkomo veshello lishmo – michayyayv!
Ayyeyde ditna resha piggul vechayyayvin alav karet, tena name sefa pasul veen bo karet.
Metivi: bamme devarim amurim – bedamim hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon;

a: Aval damim hannittanin al hammizbeach happenimi – kegon arbaim veshalosh shel yom hakkippurim, veachad asar shel par kohen mashiach, veachad asar shel par helem davar shel tzibbur; piggel ben barishona uven bashsheniyya uven bashshelishit – rabbi meir omer: piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet; vachachamim omrim: en bo karet ad sheyyefaggel bechol hammattir.
Katane miha piggel ben barishona ben bashsheniyya ben bashshelishit – ufelig!
Amar rav yitzchak bar avin: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheppiggel bishchita, dechad mattir hu. i hachi, may tama derabbanan?

Amar rava: man chachamim – rabbi elyazar hi. ditnan: hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat nesachim; shehikriv meachat mehen kezayit bachutz – chayyayv. verabbi elyazar poter, ad sheyyakriv et kullan.
Vehaamar rava: umode rabbi elyazar bedamim; ditnan, rabbi elyazar verabbi shimon omrim: mimmakom sheppasak – mishsham hu matchil!
Ella amar rava: kegon sheppiggel barishona, veshatak bashsheniyya, vechazar ufiggel bashshelishit.
Mahu detema: i salka datach al daat rishona hu mihdar – piggule bashshelishit lema li? ka mashma lan. matkef la rav ashe: midde "shatak" katane?!

Ella amar rav ashe: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheppiggel barishona uvashsheniyya uvashshelishit; mahu detema: i salka datach kol haose al daat rishona hu ose – mihdar piggule bechol chada vachada lema li? ka mashma lan.
b: Veha "ben ben" katane! kashya.

Amar mar, rabbi meir omer: piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet. mikkede karet la michayyayv ad sheyyikrevu kol mattirav – deamar mar: keharetzaat kasher kach haretzaat pasul; ma haretzaat kasher – ad sheyyikrevu kol mattirav, af haretzaat pasul – ad sheyyikrevu kol mattirav.
Veha kevan dechashshev beh bifnim pesula – keman dela adde dame; ki hadar madde bahechol – mayya bealma hu deka madde!
Amar rabba: mashkachat la bearbaa parim uvearbaa seirim.
Rava amar: afillu tema befar echad vesair echad, lefiggulo meratztze.
Arbaim veshalosh. veha tanya arbaim vesheva! ha keman deamar mearvin lakkeranot, veha keman deamar en mearvin lakkeranot.
Veha tanya arbaim ushemone! ha keman deamar shirayim meakkevin, ha keman deamar en shirayim meakkevin.
Metivi: bamme devarim amurim – bikmitza, bemattan keli uvehilluch;

Aval ba lo lehaketara – natan et hakkometz bemachshava veet hallevona bishtika, o shennatan et hakkometz bishtika veet hallevona bemachshava – rabbi meir omer: piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet. vachachamim omrim: en bo karet ad sheyyefaggel bechol hammattir.
Katane miha et hakkometz bishtika veet hallevona bemachshava – ufelig! ema: kevar natan et hallevona bemachshava.
Chada, dehayynu resha! veod, ha tanya: veachar kach! kashya.
Mishna veellu devarim sheen chayyayvin alehem mishshum piggul – hakkometz, vehakketoret, vehallevona,

a: Uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, vehaddam, vehannesachim habbain bifne atzman. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: af habbain im habbehema.

Log shemen shel metzora – rabbi shimon omer: en chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, verabbi meir omer: chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul; sheddam haasham mattiro, vechol sheyyesh lo mattirin ben laadam ben lammizbeach – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul.

Haola – damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach veorah lakkohanim. olat haof – damah mattir et besarah lemizbeach. chattat haof – damah mattir et besarah lakkohanim. parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim – daman mattir et emurehen likarev.
Rabbi shimon omer: kol sheeno al hammizbeach hachitzon kishlamim, en chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul.

Gemara amar ulla: kometz piggul sheheelo al gabbe hammizbeach – paka piggulo mimmennu; im acherim mevi lide piggul, hu atzmo lo kol shekken?! may kaamar? hachi kaamar: im eno mitkabbel, heach mevi acherim lide piggul?

May ka mashma lan? i deen chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul – tenena, ellu devarim sheen chayyayvin alehem mishshum piggul: hakkometz, vehakketoret, vehallevona, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat nesachim, vehaddam!
Ella deim alu lo yerdu – tenena: hallan, vehayyotze, vehattame, veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo – im alu lo yerdu!
Veella deim yerdu yaalu – ha name tenena: keshem sheim alu lo yerdu, kach im yerdu lo yaalu! la tzericha, shemmashla bahen haur.
Ha name amra ulla chada zimna, deamar ulla: lo shanu ella shello mashla bahen haur, aval mashla bahen haur – yaalu!
b: Mahu detema: hane mille ever – dimchabbar; aval kometz, demipperat – ema la; ka mashma lan.
Amar rav achay: hilkach, hay kometz piggul, defalgeh machet aara ufalgeh assekeh ammaaracha, umashla bo haur – massekna leh lechulleh lechattechilla.

Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: happiggul vehannotar vehattame sheheelan legabbe mizbeach – paka issur mehen. amar rav chisda: mare dechi; mizbeach – mikve tohora?! amar rabbi zera: shemmashla bahen haur.
Metiv rabbi yitzchak bar bisna: acherim omrim: "vetumato alav" – mi shettumea porachat mimmennu; yatza basar – sheen tumea porachat mimmennu. veim ita, hare tumea porachat mimmennu al yede haur!
Amar rava: al yede mikve kaamrinan. midde mikve ketiv?! ella amar rav pappa: bivsar shelamim askinan, dela chaze lehakerava.
Ravina amar: "vetumato alav" – mi shettumea porachat mimmennu keshehu shalem; yatza basar – davar sheen tumea porachat keshehu shalem, ella keshehu chaser.
Gufa: "vetumato alav" – betumeat hagguf hakkatuv medabber.

Atta omer betumeat hagguf; o eno ella betumeat basar? neemar kan: "tumato", veneemar lehallan: "tumato (alav) [bo]" – ma lehallan betumeat hagguf hakkatuv medabber, af kan betumeat hagguf hakkatuv medabber.

Rabbi yose omer: hoil veneemru kadashim bilshon rabbim, veneemra tumea bilshon yachid – betumeat hagguf hakkatuv medabber. rabbi omer: "veachal" – betumeat hagguf hakkatuv medabber. acherim amru: "vetumato alav" – mi shettumea porachat mimmennu; yatza basar, sheen tumea porachat mimmennu.

Amar mar: rabbi omer: "veachal" – betumeat hagguf hakkatuv medabber. may mashma? amar rava: kol kera dela mefaresh leh rav yitzchak bar avudimi, vechol matnita dela mefaresho la (rav) zeeri – la mipparsha.
Hachi amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi: hoil ufatach hakkatuv bilshon nekeva vesiyyem bilshon nekeva, uleshon zachar baemtza – betumeat hagguf hakkatuv medabber.

Matnita – detanya: im neemru kallot lamma neemru chamurot, veim (neemar) [neemru] chamurot lamma (neemar) [neemru] kallot? im (neemar) [neemru] kallot velo chamurot – hayiti omer: al hakkallot belav, veal hachamurot bemita; lechach (neemar) [neemru] chamurot. veim (neemar) [neemru] chamurot velo neemru kallot – hayiti omer: al hachamurot yehe chayyayv, veal hakkallot yehe patur; lechach neemar kallot.
May kallot umay chamurot? ilema kallot maaser, chamurot teruma – hayiti omer bemita?! hasheta name ha bemita!
[Vetu], vei lo (neemar) [neemru] – hayiti omer bemita?! dayyo labba min haddin – lihyot kanniddon!
Ella kallot – tumeat sheretz, chamurot – tumeat met.
Uvemay? i bitruma – idde veidde hu bemita! vetu, lechach neemru chamurot – divlav?! ha bemita hi! (vei lo (neemar) [neemru], hayiti omer bemita?! dayyo labba min haddin – lihyot kanniddon!)
Vei baachilat maaser –

a: Im lo neemru chamurot, hayiti omer al hachamurot bemita?! ha mittumeat sheretz kaatya, vedayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon!

Amar zeeri: kallot – tumeat sheretz, chamurot – tumeat met. vehachi kaamar: illu neemar tumeat sheretz veneemar maaser uteruma, velo neemra tumeat met – hayiti omer: [kallot] al hakkallot belav, veal hachamurot bemita;
Umiddekallot al hachamurot bemita – chamurot name al hakkallot bemita; lechach neemru chamurot.
Kol sheyyesh lo mattirin, ben leadam ben lemizbeach – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul.
Tanu rabbanan: o eno mevi ella kayyotze bishlamim; ma shelamim meyuchadim – neechalin lishne yamim velayla echad, af kol neechol lishne yamim velayla echad;
Neechol leyom valayla minnayin? talmud lomar: "mibbesar" – kol (sheshshirin) [sheshsheyarav] neechalin. ola sheen sheyareha neechalin, minnayin? talmud lomar: "zevach".
Minnayin lerabbot haofot vehammenachot, ad sheani merabbe log shemen shel metzora? talmud lomar: "asher hem makdishim li".
Veate notar "chillul"–"chillul" mittumea, veate piggul "avon"–"avon" minnotar.

Umeachar shessofo lerabbot kol davar, lamma neemar shelamim meatta? lomar lach: ma shelamim meyuchadim – sheyyesh lahen mattirin ben laadam ben lammizbeach, af kol sheyyesh lo mattirin ben laadam ben lammizbeach – chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul.

Haola – damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach, veorah lakkohanim. olat haof – damah mattir et besarah lammizbeach. chattat haof – damah mattir et besarah lakkohanim. parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim – damam mattir et emurehen likrav.
Umotzi ani et hakkometz, veet hallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat nesachim, vehaddam.

Rabbi shimon omer: ma shelamim meyuchadin – sheyyesh bo al mizbeach hachitzon vechayyayvin alav, af kol sheyyeshnan al mizbeach hachitzon – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul. yatzu parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim, hoil sheen al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim – en chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul.
Amar [mar]: kayyotze bishlamim. may nihu? bechor, deneechol lishne yamim velayla echad. bemay ate? i bema matzinu – ikka lemifrach:
Ma lishlamim – shehen teunin semicha unesachim, utenufat chaze vashok!
Ella meim heachol yeachel".
Hane tere kelale dismichi ahadade ninhu! amar rava, kidamri bemareva: kol makom sheatta motze shene kelalot hassemuchim ze laze, hattel perat benehem vedunem bichlal uferat.

Ad sheani merabbe log shemen shel metzora. ha manni – rabbi meir hi, detanya: log shemen shel metzora – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, divre rabbi meir. ema sefa: umotzi ani minchat nesachim vehaddam – atan lerabbanan!

Detanya: nische vehema – chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul, mippene sheddam hazzevach mattiran likarev. divre rabbi meir. amru lo: vahalo adam mevi et zevachav hayyom, unesachin mikkan ad asara yamim! amar lahen: af ani lo amarti, ella bevain im hazzevach.
Amar rav yosef: ha manni – rabbi hi, deamar: log shemen shel metzora – mattenotav sharu leh; umiddemattenotav sharu leh – mattenotav mefaggeli leh.
Detanya: log shemen shel metzora – moalin bo, ad sheyyizrok haddam. nizrak haddam – lo nehenin velo moalin.
Rabbi omer: moalin, ad sheyyitten mattenotav. veshavin sheasur baachila ad sheyyitten mattan sheva umattan behonot.
Amruha kammeh derabbi yirmeya, amar: gavra rabba kerav yosef, lema ki ha milleta?!
b: Hare log [habba] bifne atzmo – dilchulle alma mattenotav sharu leh, vela mefaggelin leh! detanya: log shemen shel metzora – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, mippene sheddam mattiro labbehonot. divre rabbi meir.
Amru lo lerabbi meir: vahalo adam mevi ashamo achshav, velog mikkan vead asara yamim! amar lahen: af ani lo amarti, ella beva im haasham.

Ella amar rabbi yirmeya: leolam rabbi meir hi, usemi mikkan nesachim. amar abbaye: leolam la tisme; vetana log habba im haasham – vehu haddin linsachim habbain im hazzevach, vahadar tana nesachim habbain bifne atzman – vehu haddin lelog habba lifne atzmo.
Chattat haof – damah mattir et besarah lakkohanim. mena hane mille? detane levi:
"Kol korbanam" – lerabbot log shemen shel metzora. salka datach amena: "min haesh" ketav rachamana, vehay lav motar min haesh hu; ka mashma lan.

"Lechol minchatam" – lerabbot minchat omer uminchat hakkenaot. salka datach amena: "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem" – uminchat haomer lehattir atya, uminchat kenaot levarer avon kaatya; ka mashma lan.
"Ulechol chattatam" – lerabbot chattat haof. salka datach amena: nevela hi.
"Lechol ashamam" – lerabbot asham nazir vaasham metzora. salka datach amena: lehacheshir kaatu; ka mashma lan.
Asham metzora – behedya ketiv beh! ella lerabbot asham nazir kaasham metzora.
"Asher yashivu" – ze gezel hagger. "lecha hu" – shellecha yihye, afillu lekaddesh bo et haishsha.
Tanya, rabbi elazar omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili: piggel bedavar hannaase bachutz – piggel. bedavar hannaase bifnim – lo piggel.

Ketzad? haya omed bachutz, veamar: "hareni shochet lehazzot middamo lemachar" – lo piggel, shemmachshava bachutz bedavar hannaase bifnim lo piggel. haya omed bifnim, veamar: "hareni mazze al menat lehaketir emurim velishpoch shirayim lemachar" – lo piggel, shemmachshava bifnim bedavar hannaase bachutz.
Aval haya omed bachutz, veamar: "hareni shochet lishpoch shirayim lemachar", o "lehaketir emurim lemachar" – piggel, shemmachshava bachutz bedavar hannaase bachutz.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may kera? "kaasher yuram mishshor zevach hashshelamim" – vechi ma lamadnu mishshor zevach hashshelamim meatta?

Ella makkish par kohen mashiach leshor zevach hashshelamim; ma shor zevach hashshelamim – ad sheyyehu maasav umachshevotav al mizbeach hachitzon, af par kohen mashiach – ad sheyyehu machshevotav umaasav al hammizbeach hachitzon.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: halacha kerabbi elazar sheamar mishshum rabbi yose.
Amar rava:

a: Hilcheta limshicha?! amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, kol shechitat kodashim la litne – hilcheta limshicha hu! ella derosh vekabbel sachar; hacha name, derosh vekabbel sachar. hachi kaamena lach: hilcheta lema li? lishshana acharina, amar leh: halacha kaamena.
Mishna kodshe goyim – en chayyayvin alehem mishshum piggul, notar vetame; vehashshochatan bachutz – patur. divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yose mechayyev.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: kodshe goyim – lo nehenin velo moalin, veen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame,
Veen osin temura, veen meviin nesachim, aval korbanan taun nesachim. divre rabbi shimon.
Amar rabbi yose: roe ani bechullan lehachemir, shenneemar bahen "laAdonai". bamme devarim amurim – bekodshe mizbeach, aval bekodshe bedek habbayit – moalin bahen.
Lo nehenin velo moalin. lo nehenin – midderabbanan.
Velo moalin – degamar meila "chet"–"chet" mitteruma, devitruma ketiv: "bene yisrael" – velo goyim.
Veen chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame. may tama? deate piggul "avon"–"avon" minnotar,
Veate notar "chillul"–"chillul" mittumea, uvetumea ketiv: "bene yisrael" – velo goyim.
Veen osin temura. may tama? deittakkash temura lemasar behema, umasar behema ittakkash lemasar dagan, uvemasar dagan ketiv: "bene yisrael" – velo goyim.
Vechi davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh?! masar dagan chullin hu.
Hanicha leman deamar batar melammed azlinan; ella leman deamar batar lamed azlinan, may ikka lememar?
Ella masar behema chova – sheen kavua lah zeman hu, vechova sheen lah zeman kavua – yisrael mayytu, goyim la mayytu.
Veen meviin nesachim. tanu rabbanan: "ezrach" – ezrach mevi nesachim, veen haggoy mevi nesachim. yachol lo tehe olato teuna nesachim? talmud lomar: "kacha".
Amar rabbi yose: roe ani bechullan lehachemir. bamme devarim amurim – bekodshe mizbeach kulei. may tama?
Kasavar: ki gamra meila "chet"–"chet" mitteruma – dumeya ditruma, dekaddisha kedushshat hagguf; aval kedushshat bedek habbayit, dikdushshat damim – la.
Tanu rabbanan: dam shennitma uzerako, beshogeg – huretza,
b: Bemezid – lo huretza. bamme devarim amurim – beyachid; aval betzibbur, ben beshogeg ben bemezid – huretza. uvegoyim, ben beshogeg uven bemezid – lo huretza.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa: keman? dela kerabbi yose; dei rabbi yose, haamar: bechullan ani roe lehachemir!
Amar lehu rav pappa: afillu tema rabbi yose, shane hatam deamar kera: "lahem" – lahem velo legoyim.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa: ella meatta, "asher hem makdishim" – hachi name, hem velo goyim?!
Ella amar rav ashe, amar kera: "leratzon lahem" – vegoyim lav bene haretzaa ninhu.

Mishna devarim sheen chayyayvim alehem mishshum piggul, chayyayvin alehen mishshum notar umishshum tame; chutz min haddam. rabbi shimon mechayyev bedavar sheddarkan leechol, aval haetzim vehallevona vehakketoret en chayyayvin alav mishshum tumea.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: yachol lo yehu chayyayvin mishshum tumea ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin – ben leadam ben lemizbeach?
Vedin hu; uma piggul, shehu bikvia uvidia achat velo huttar mikkelalo – en chayyayvin alav ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin, ben leadam ben lemizbeach;
Tumea, shehi beole veyored uvishte yediot vehuttera mikkelalah – eno din sheeno chayyayv ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin, ben leadam ben lemizbeach?
Talmud lomar: "asher hem makdishim li".
Yachol miyyad? talmud lomar: "yikrav". amar rabbi elazar: vechi yesh nogea shehu chayyayv?!
Ella ma talmud lomar "yikrav"? behucheshar [basar] likkarev hakkatuv medabber. ha ketzad? yesh lo mattirin – mishsheyyikravo mattirin, en lo mattirin – mishsheyyikdash bichli.
Ashkechan tumea; notar menalan? ate "chillul"–"chillul" mittumea.
Velelaf "avon"–"avon" mippiggul!
Mistabbera mittumea have leh lemelaf, shekken gezel siman.
Adderabba, mippiggul hava leh lemelaf – shekken huttar, tzitz, tahor, bizman, karev; vehane nefishan!
Ella middetane levi. detane levi: minnayin sheaf bifsul zeman hakkatuv medabber? talmud lomar: "velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael" –

a: Bishne chillulin hakkatuv medabber; echad pesul notar, veechad pesul tumea.
Chutz min haddam kulei. mena hane mille? amar ulla, amar kera: "vaani netattiv lachem" – shellachem yehe.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana, amar kera: "lechapper" – lechappara netattiv, velo limila.
Rabbi yochanan amar, amar kera: "hu" – hu lifne kappara kilachar kappara; ma achar kappara en bo meila, af lifne kappara en bo meila.
Ema leachar kappara kelifne kappara – ma lifne kappara yesh bo meila, af leachar kappara yesh bo meila! en lecha davar shennaaset mitzvato umoalin bo.
Vela?! vahare terumat haddeshen!
Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen uvigde chehunna shene ketuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbain keechad en melammedin.
Hanicha lerabbanan deamri "vehinnicham sham" – melammed shetteunin geniza.
Ella lerabbi dosa, deamar: muttarot hen lechohen hedyot, uvilvad shello yishtammesh bahen leyom hakkippurim acher – may ikka lememar?
Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene ketuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin may ikka lememar?
Tere miute ketivi; hacha ketiv: "haarufa", vehatam ketiv: "vesamo".
Utelata kerae bedam lema li?
Lemaote mimmeila, minnotar umittumea.
Aval piggul la tzerich kera, ditnan: kol sheyyesh lo mattirin, ben laadam ben lammizbeach – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul. vedam gufeh mattir hu.
Amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha karetot bishlamim lamma?
b: Achat lichlal, veachat lifrat, veachat lidvarim sheenan neechalin.
Ulerabbi shimon deamar: devarim sheen neechalin – en chayyayvin alehem mishshum tumea, leetoye may? leetoye chattaot happenimiyyot.
Salka datach amena, hoil veamar rabbi shimon: kol sheeno al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim – en chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, mishshum tumea name la lichayyayv; ka mashma lan.
Numi rabbi shimon mechayyev et sheddarko leechol kulei. ittemar: rabbi yochanan veresh lakish, rabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina – chad mehay zuza vechad mehay zuza;
Chad amar: machloket betumeat basar, aval betumeat hagguf – divre hakkol eno loke.
Vechad amar: kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo. may tama? kevan dekarena beh "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame", karenan beh "vetumato alav".

Rav tavyome matne hachi; rav kahana matne hachi: chad mehay zuza vechad mehay zuza assefa – chad amar: machloket betumeat hagguf, aval betumeat basar divre hakkol loke; vechad amar: kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo.
Amar rava: mistabbera keman deamar kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo. may tama? kevan dela karena beh "vetumato alav venichreta", la karena beh "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel".
Vehaamar mar: "vehabbasar" – lerabbot etzim ulevona! (lefoslah) [lifsula] bealma.
Mishna leshem shishsha devarim hazzevach nizbach: leshem zevach, leshem zoveach, leshem hashshem, leshem ishshim, leshem reach, leshem nichoach. vehachattat vehaasham – leshem chet.
Amar rabbi yose: af mi shello haya belibbo leshem echad mikkol ellu – kasher; shehu tenay bet din, sheen hammachshava holechet ella achar haoved.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: "ola" – leshem ola, leappoke leshem shelamim dela. "ishshim" – leshem ishshim, leappoke kevava dela.
"Reach" – leshem reach, leappoke evarim shetztzelaan veheelan – dela. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: evarim shetztzelaan veheelan – en bahen mishshum reach.
"Nichoach" – leshem hanachat ruach. "laAdonai" – leshem mi sheamar vehaya haolam.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: chattat sheshshechatah leshem ola – pesula. leshem chullin – keshera. amar rabbi elazar: may tama derav? "velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael" – kodashim mechallelin kodashim, veen chullin mechallelin kodashim.
Metiv rabba, amar rabbi yose: af mi shello haya belibbo leshem echad mikkol ellu – kasher, shehu tenay bet din. tama shello haya belibbo kelal, ha haya belibbo leshem chullin – pasul!
Amar leh abbaye: dilma lo haya kelal – kasher umeratztze, ha haya belibbo leshem chullin – kasher veeno meratztze.
Amar rabbi elazar: chattat sheshshechatah leshem chullin – keshera. mishshum chullin – pesula. kediva minneh shemuel merav huna:

a: Minnayin lammitassek bekadashim shehu pasul? shenneemar "veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai" – ad shettehe shechita leshem ben bakar.
Amar leh: zo beyadenu hi; leakkev minnayin? amar leh: "lirtzonchem tizbachuhu" – ledatechem zevuychu.

Sheen hammachshava holechet ella achar haoved. matnitin dela ki hay tanna – detanya, amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose: shamati shehabbealim mefaggelin. amar rava: may tama derabbi elazar berabbi yose? deamar kera: "vehikriv hammakriv".
Amar abbaye: rabbi elazar berabbi yose verabbi eliezer verabbi shimon ben elazar kullehu sevira lehu: ze mechashshev veze oved – havya machshava. rabbi elazar berabbi yose – ha daamaran.
Rabbi eliezer – ditnan: hashshochet legoy – shechitato keshera, verabbi eliezer posel.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar – ditnan, kelal amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: kol sheen kasher lehatzenia, veen matzniin kamohu; hucheshar laze vehitznio, uva acher vehotzio – nitchayyev ze bemachshava shel ze.
Tarvayyhu it lehu derabbi elazar berabbi yose – hasheta bachutz amrinan, bifnim mibbaya?!
Rabbi elazar berabbi yose let lehu detarvayyhu – dilma bifnim hu deamrinan, bachutz la amrinan.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar it leh derabbi eliezer – hasheta beshabbat amrinan, baavoda zara mibbaya?!
Rabbi eliezer let leh derabbi shimon ben elazar – dilma baavoda zara hu deamrat keen bifnim, aval shabbat – melechet machshevet asra tora.
Hadaran alach bet shammay
Mishna ezehu mekoman shel zevachim? kodshe kadashim – shechitatan batztzafon.

Par vesair shel yom hakkippurim – shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichle sharet batztzafon; vedaman taun hazzaya al ben habbaddim, veal happarochet, veal mizbach hazzahav – mattana achat mehen meakkevet. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon, veim lo natan lo ikkev.
Parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim – shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon; vedaman taun hazzaya al happarochet veal mizbach hazzahav –
b: Mattana achat mehen meakkevet. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon, veim lo natan lo ikkev. ellu vaellu nisrafin abbet haddeshen.
Gemara venitne name: vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon! kevan deikka asham metzora dekibbul damo bayyad hu – shayyeyreh.
Vela?! veha katane la lekamman: asham nazir vaasham metzora – shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon!
Meikkara savar kibbul damo bayyad hu; shayyeyreh. vechevan dela saggi leh ella bichli – hadar tanyeh.
Detanya: "velakach" – yachol bichli? talmud lomar: "venatan" – ma netina beatzmo shel kohen, af lekicha beatzmo shel kohen.

Yachol af lemizbeach ken? talmud lomar: "ki kachattat haasham hu" – ma chattat teuna keli, af asham taun keli. nimtzeta atta omer: asham metzora – shene kohanim mekabbelin et damo, echad bayyad veechad bichli. ze shekkibbelo bichli – ba lo etzel mizbeach, veze shekkibbelo bayyad – ba lo etzel metzora.

a: Par vesair shel yom hakkippurim kulei. mikkede tzafon beola ketiv, nitne ola beresha!
Chattat – ayyeyde deate midderasha, chabbiva leh.
Venitne chattaot hachitzonot! ayyeyde denichnas daman lifnay velifnim, chabbiva leh.
Vetzafona beola hecha ketiva? "veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona".
Ashkechan ben tzon, ben bakar mena lan? amar kera: "veim min hatztzon" – vav mosif al inyan rishon, veyilmad elyon mittachton.
Hanicha leman deamar melammedin; ella leman deamar en melammedin, may ikka lememar?
Detanya: "veim nefesh vegomer" – lechayyev al sefek meilot asham taluy. divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim potrin. may, lav beha ka mippalgi: mar savar lemedin, umar savar en lemedin?
Amar rav pappa: dechulle alma lemedin; vehayeynu tama derabbanan: neemar kan "mitzvot", veneemar bechattat chelev "mitzvot";
Ma lehallan – davar shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat, af kan – shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat.
Verabbi akiva – ma lehallan bikvua, af kan bikvua; leappoke chattat detumeat mikdash vekadashav, deole veyored hu.
Verabbanan – en gezera shava lemechetza. verabbi akiva name, en gezera shava lemechetza!
In hachi name; vehacha beha kamippalgi: rabbi akiva savar: "veim nefesh" ketiv – vav mosif al inyan rishon;
Verabbanan name, hachtiv "veim nefesh"! lema beha kamippalgi – demar savar hekkesh adif, umar savar gezera shava adif?
La, dechulle alma – dehekkesh adif; veamri lach rabbanan: tachton hu degamar meelyon –
Leasham bechesef shekalim. shello tomar: lo yehe sefeko chamur mivvaddao; ma vaddao chattat bat danka, af sefeko asham bar danka.
Verabbi akiva, ha sevara mena leh? nafka leh mizzot torat haasham" – tora achat lechol haashamot.
Tinach man deit leh "torat"; man delet leh "torat" mehecha gamar? gamar "beerkecha"–"beerkecha".
Tinach hecha dichtiv "beerkecha"; asham shifcha charufa dela ketiv beh "beerkecha", may ikka lememar?
Gamar "beel"–"beel".
Chattat mena lan devaaya tzafon? dichtiv: "veshachat et hachattat bimkom haola".
Ashkechan shechita, kabbala mena lan? dichtiv: "velakach hakkohen middam hachattat".
Mekabbel atzmo mena lan? amar kera: "velakach" – "lo yikkach".
Ashkechan lemitzva, leakkev minnayin? kera achrina ketiv: "veshachat oto bimkom asher yishchat et haola", vetanya: hechan ola [nishchetet] – batztzafon; af ze batztzafon.
b: Vechi mikkan atta lamed?! vahalo kevar neemar: "bimkom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat"! ha lema yatza – likboa lo makom, sheim lo shechatah batztzafon pasul.
Atta omer lechach yatza; o eno ella shezze taun tzafon, veen acher taun tzafon? talmud lomar: "veshachat et hachattat bimkom haola" – ze bana av lechol chattaot, sheyyehu teunot tzafon.
Ashkechan seir nasi – ben lemitzva ben leakkev; shear chattaot name – ashkechan lemitzva; leakkev mena lan?
Dichtiv bechisba uchetiv bisira.
Ella "oto" lema li?
Mibbee leh lechidtanya: "oto batztzafon" – veen seir nachshon batztzafon.
Vetanya: "vesamach yado al rosh hassair" – lerabbot sair nachshon lismicha. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: lerabbot seire avoda zara lismicha.
Salka datach amena: hoil veitrabbo lismicha – itrabbo name letzafon; ka mashma lan.
Matkef la ravina: hanicha lerabbi yehuda; lerabbi shimon may ikka lememar?
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav tavi leravina: ulerabbi yehuda mi nicha?! lemay deitrabbi itrabbi, umay dela itrabbi la itrabbi!
Vechi tema, i la maateh kera – hava amena tete bevinyan av; im ken, semicha gufa tete mibbinyan av! ella middorot la gamrinan; hacha name middorot la gamrinan!
Veella "oto batztzafon" – veen shochet batztzafon?
Shochet – midderabbi achiyya nafka! detanya, rabbi achiyya omer: "veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona" – ma talmud lomar?
Lefi shemmatzinu omed batztzafon umekabbel batztzafon, veim amad baddarom vekibbel batztzafon pasul; yachol af ze ken? talmud lomar "oto" – oto batztzafon, veen hashshochet batztzafon.

Ella "oto batztzafon" – veen ben of batztzafon. detanya: yachol yehe ben of taun tzafon? vedin hu; uma ben tzon, shello kava lo kohen – kava lo tzafon; ben of, shekkava lo kohen – eno din sheyyikba lo tzafon? talmud lomar: "oto".
Ma leven tzon, shekken kava lo keli!
Ella, "oto batztzafon" – veen pesach batztzafon.

Detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: yachol yehe pesach taun tzafon? vedin hu; uma ola, shekken la kava lo zeman lishchitato – kava lo tzafon; pesach, shekkava lo zeman lishchitato – eno din sheyyikba lo tzafon? talmud lomar: "oto".
Ma leola, shekken kalil!
Mechattat – ma lechattat, shekken mechapperet al chayyayve charetot!
Measham – ma leasham, shekken kodshe kadashim! mikkullan name – shekken kodshe kadashim!

Leolam kedaamaran meikkara: "oto batztzafon" – veen shochet batztzafon. udekashya lach midderabbi achiyya nafka lan – lav lemaote shochet batztzafon; ella en shochet batztzafon, aval mekabbel batztzafon.
Mekabbel millakach"–"velakach" nafka! "lakach"–"velakach" la mashma leh.
Ashkechan shechita beola – lemitzva, kabbala name – lemitzva ashkechan; shechita vekabbala leakkev menalan?
Amar rav adda bar ahava, veittema rabba bar shela: kal vachomer; uma chattat, habbaa mikkoach ola – meakkevet; ola, shebbaa chattat mikkochah – eno din shemmeakkevet?
Ma lechattat, shekken mechapperet al chayyayve charetot!
Amar ravina: ha kashya leh lerav adda bar ahava – kelum matzinu tafel chamur min haikkar?!
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: vela?!

a: Vahare maaser – dehu nifde, veillu lakuach bechesef maaser eno nifde – ditnan: hallakuach bechesef maaser shennitma – yippade. rabbi yehuda omer: yikkaver. nitma in, lo nitma la!
Hatam la allima kedushshateh lemitpas pidyoneh.
Vahare temura – deillu kodashim la chayyli al baal mum kavua, veillu ihi chayyla!
Temura mikkoach kadashim ka atya, vekadashim mikkoach chullin (kaate) [kaatu].
Hare pesach – dehu eno taun semicha unesachim utenufat chaze vashok, veillu motar dideh taun semicha unesachim utenufat chaze vashok!
Pesach bishar yemot hashshana – shelamim hu.
Veibbaet ema, amar kera: "haola" – bimkomah tehe.
Asham menalan devae tzafon? dichtiv: "bimkom asher yishchatu et haola yishchatu et haasham".
Ashkechan shechita, kabbala mena lan? "veet damo yizrok" – kibbul damo name batztzafon.
Mekabbel atzmo mena lan? "damo"–"veet damo".
Ashkechan lemitzva, leakkev mena lan? kera acharina ketiv: "veshachat et hakkeves".
Vehay lehachi hu daata?! hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza liddon bedavar hechadash, i atta rashshay lehacheziro lichlalo ad sheyyachzirennu hakkatuv lichlalo beferush.

Ketzad? "veshachat et hakkeves bimkom asher yishchat et hachattat veet haola bimkom hakkodesh, ki kachattat haasham hu vegomer" – sheen talmud lomar "kachattat haasham"; ma talmud lomar "kachattat haasham"?
Lefi sheyyatza asham metzora liddon bedavar hechadash – bevohen yad uvohen regel veozen yemanit; yachol lo yehe taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach?
Talmud lomar: "kachattat haasham hu" – ma chattat teuna mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach, af asham metzora taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach.
Im ken, nichtov behay vela nichtov behay.
Hanicha i sevira lan yatza liddon bedavar hechadash – ihu hu dela gamar mikkelalo,
b: Aval kelalo gamar minneh (letzafon) shappir. ella i sevira lan dela hu gamar mikkelalo vela kelalo gamar minneh – hay legufeh itzterich!
Kevan deahdereh, ahdereh.
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: ema ki ahdereh kera – legabbe mattan damim veemurin, devae kehunna; aval shechita, dela baaya kehunna – la mibbee tzafon!
Im ken, nema kera "ki kechattat hu"; may "kechattat haasham"? kishar ashamot yihye.
Lema li leakshoye lechattat, lema li leakshoye leola?
Amar ravina: itzterich; i akkesheh lechattat vela akkesheh leola – hava amena: chattat mehechan lamda – meola; davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh.
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: venaykkeshe leola, vela naykkeshe lechattat!

Hava amena: davar hallamed behekkesh – chozer umelammed behekkesh; vechi tema: (naykashey) [naykkesheh] akkoshe lechattat, nicha leh demakkesh leh leikkar vela nakkesh leh letafel; lehachi akkesheh lechattat veakkesheh leola – lememar davar hallamed behekkesh sheeno chozer umelammed behekkesh.
Rava amar mehacha, dichtiv: "kaasher yuram mishshor zevach hashshelamim" – lemay hilcheta? i leyoteret hakkaved ushete hakkelayot – begufeh ketiv!
Mishshum devae agmore yoteret hakkaved ushete hakkelayot mippar helem davar shel tzibbur lisire avoda zara; begufeh la ketiv, umippar kohen mashiach hu degamar;
Lehachi itzterich "kaasher yuram" – denehve keman dichtiv begufeh, vela nihve davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: velichteveh begufeh, vela nakkesh!

I ketav begufeh vela akkesh – hava amena davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh; vechi tema (nakeshay) [nakkesheh] akkoshe – nicha leh dechatveh begufeh middeakkesh leh akkoshe; lehachi katveh veakkesheh, lememra davar hallamed behekkesh en chozer umelammed behekkesh.
(Hekkesh, ugezera shava, kal vachomer – siman)
Davar hallamed behekkesh, en chozer umelammed mehekkesh – i midderava, i midderavina. davar hallamed behekkesh, mahu sheyyelammed bigzera shava?
Ta shema, rabbi natan ben avtulemos omer: minnayin lifricha bivgadim shehi tehora? neemar karachat vegabbachat babbegadim, veneemar karachat vegabbachat baadam;
Ma lehallan – parach bechullo tahor, af kan – parach bechullo tahor.
Vehatam mena lan? dichtiv: "merosho vead raglav" – veittakkash rosho (laregel) [leraglav]; ma lehallan, kullo hafach lavan perach bechullo – tahor; af kan, kullo hafach lavan parach bechullo – tahor.
Amar rabbi yochanan: bechol hattora kullah lemedin lamed millamed, chutz min hakkodashim – sheen danin lamed millamed.
Deim ken – lo yeamer tzafona beasham, vetete bigzera shava dekodshe kadashim" mechattaot;
Lav lememra dedavar hallamed behekkesh en chozer umelammed bigzera shava?
Vedilma mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lechattat, shekken mechapperet al chayyayve charetot!
"Kodshe kadashim" yattire ketivi.
Davar hallamed mehekkesh, chozer umelammed bekal vachomer –

a: Middetana deve rabbi yishmael.

Davar hallamed behekkesh, mahu sheyyelammed bevinyan av? amar rabbi yirmeya: la lichtov tzafona beasham, vetete mibbinyan av mechattat; lemay hilcheta katveh? lav lememra dedavar hallamed behekkesh en chozer umelammed bevinyan av?
Velitamaych, tete mibbinyan av meola! may tama la ate – mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma leola shekken kalil; chattat name ikka lemifrach: ma lechattat shekken mechapperet al chayyayve charetot.
Chada mechada – la atya; tete chada mittarte!
Mehe tete? la nichtov rachamana ola, vetete mechattat veasham? ma lehanach shekken mechapperin.
La nichtov rachamana bechattat, vetete mehanach? ma lehanach shekken zecharim.
La nichtov beasham, vetete mehanach? ma lehanach shekken yeshnan betzibbur kivyachid.

Davar hallamed bigzera shava, mahu sheyyelammed behekkesh? amar rav pappa: "vezot torat zevach hashshelamim [vegomer] im al toda" – lamadnu letoda shebba min hammaaser, middeashkechan shelamim deatu mimmaaser.
Shelamim gufayyhu mena lan? dichtiv "sham"–"sham".
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: masar dagan chullin bealma hu!
Amar leh, amar amra: lamed kodesh umelammed kodesh?!
Davar hallamed bigzera shava, mahu sheyyelammed bigzera shava? amar rame bar chama, tanya: "solet murbechet" – lamadnu lirvucha shebbaa solet.
Challot minnayin? talmud lomar: "challot"–"challot". rekikin minnayin? talmud lomar: "matztzot"–"matztzot".
Amar leh ravina: mimmay dematztzot"–"matztzot" mechallot gamar? dilma mimmaafe tannur gamar!
Ella amar rava, tanya: "vekirbo ufirsho vehotzi" – melammed shemmotzio shalem.
Yachol yisrefennu shalem? neemar kan: "rosho ucheraav", veneemar lehallan: "rosho ucheraav"; ma lehallan al yede nittuach, af kan al yede nittuach.
I – ma lehallan behefshet, af kan name behefshet?! talmud lomar: "vekirbo ufirsho". may talmuda? amar rav pappa: keshem sheppirsho bekirbo, kach besaro beoro.
Vetanya, rabbi omer: neemar kan or uvasar [vaferesh],
b: Veneemar lehallan or uvasar vaferesh; ma lehallan – al yede nittuach shello behefshet, af kan – al yede nittuach shello behefshet.

Davar hallamed bigzera shava, mahu sheyyelammed bekal vachomer? kal vachomer: uma hekkesh, sheeno melammed behekkesh – i midderava i midderavina, melammed bekal vachomer middetana deve rabbi yishmael; gezera shava, hamelammedet behekkesh midderav pappa, eno din shettelammed bekal vachomer?!
Hanicha leman deit leh derav pappa; ella leman delet leh derav pappa, may ikka lememar?

Ella kal vachomer: uma hekkesh, sheen melammed behekkesh – i midderava i midderavina, melammed bekal vachomer middetana deve rabbi yishmael; gezera shava, hamelammedet bigzera shava chavertah – midderame bar chama, eno din shettelammed bekal vachomer?!
Davar hallamed bigzera shava, mahu sheyyelammed bevinyan av? teku.

Davar hallamed bekal vachomer, mahu sheyyelammed behekkesh? kal vachomer: uma gezera shava, sheenah lemeda behekkesha midderabbi yochanan – melammed behekkesh midderav pappa; kal vachomer, hallamed mehekkesh middetana deve rabbi yishmael – eno din sheyyelammed behekkesh?!
Hanicha – leman deit leh derav pappa; ella leman delet leh derav pappa, may ikka lememar? teku.

Davar hallamed bekal vachomer, mahu sheyyelammed bigzera shava? kal vachomer: uma gezera shava, sheenah lemeda behekkesha midderabbi yochanan – melammed bigzera shava midderame bar chama; kal vachomer, hallamed behekkesh middetana deve rabbi yishmael – eno din shettelammed bigzera shava?!

Davar hallamed bekal vachomer, mahu sheyyelammed bekal vachomer? kal vachomer: uma gezera shava, sheenah lemeda behekkesh midderabbi yochanan – melammed bekal vachomer kedaamaran; kal vachomer, hallamed mehekkesh middetana deve rabbi yishmael – eno din sheyyelammed bekal vachomer?!
Vezehu kal vachomer ben kal vachomer. ben beno shel kal vachomer hu!

Ella kal vachomer: uma hekkesh, sheeno lamed behekkesh – i midderava i midderavina, melammed bekal vachomer middetana deve rabbi yishmael; kal vachomer, hallamed mehekkesh middetane deve rabbi yishmael, eno din sheyyelammed bekal vachomer?! vezehu kal vachomer ben kal vachomer.

Davar hallamed bekal vachomer, mahu sheyyelammed bevinyan av? amar rabbi yirmeya, ta shema: malak venimtzet terefa, rabbi meir omer: enah metammea bevet habbelia. rabbi yehuda omer: metammea bevet habbelia.

Amar rabbi meir, kal vachomer: uma nivlat behema, shemmetammea bemagga uvemassa – shechitatah metaheret terefatah mittumeatah; nevelat of, sheen metamme bemagga uvemassa – eno din shettehe shechitatah metaheret terefatah mittumeatah?! ma matzinu bishchita, shemmachshartah baachila –

a: Metaheret terefatah mittumeatah; af melika, shemmachshartah baachila – tetaher terefatah mittumeatah.
Rabbi yose omer: dayyah kenivlat behema tehora – sheshshechitatah metahartah, velo melikatah.
Vela hi; hatam tehve hi, mishshechita dechullin kaatyayn.
Davar hallamed bevinyan av, mahu sheyyelammed behekkesh uvigzera shava uvekal vachomer uvevinyan av?
Peshot miha chada – mippene ma amru: lan baddam – kasher? shehare lan baemurin kasher. lan beemurin kasher – shehare lan babbasar kasher.
Yotze – hoil veyotze kasher bevama.
Tame – hoil vehuttar baavodat tzibbur.
Chutz lizmanno – hoil umeratztze lefiggulo.
Chutz limkomo – hoil vehukkash lechutz lizmanno.
Shekkibbelu pesulin vezarku daman – behanach pesulin dachazu laavodat tzibbur.
Vechi danin davar shello behechshero, middavar shebbehechshero?!
Tanna mizzot torat haola" ribba samech leh.
Sheyare haddam kulei. may tama? amar kera: "el yesod mizbach haola asher petach ohel moed" – hahu defaga beresha.
Tanu rabbanan: "el yesod mizbach haola" – velo yesod mizbeach happenimi.
"El yesod mizbach haola" – en lo yesod lappenimi atzmo.
"El yesod mizbach haola" – ten yesod lammizbeach shel ola.
O eno ella mizbechah shel ola – yehe laysod? amar rabbi yishmael: kal vachomer; ma shirayim, sheen mechapperin – teunin yesod; techillat ola, shemmechapperet – eno din shetteuna yesod?!
Amar rabbi akiva: ma shirayim, sheen mechapperin veen bain lechappara – teuna yesod; techillat ola, shemmechapperet uvaa lechappara – eno din shetteuna yesod?
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "el yesod mizbach haola"? ten yesod lemizbechah shel ola.
Amar mar: "el yesod mizbach" – velo yesod mizbeach happenimi. ha mibbee leh legufeh! measher petach ohel moed" nafka.
"El yesod mizbach haola" –
b: Ten yesod lammizbeach shel ola.
Dei salka datach kedichtiv; hane lema li kera – leshirayim?! shirayim ha baray aved lehu!
Vechi tema deafech mefach –

a: Devaray legavvay udegavvay levaray; ha en lo yesod lifnimi atzmo!
O eno ella mizbechah shel ola yehe laysod. mi ketiv "el yesod haola"?! "el yesod mizbach haola" ketiv!
I hava ketiv "el yesod haola" – hava amena: bizkifa el yesod; hasheta dichtiv: "el yesod mizbach haola" – aggaggo disod.
Amar rabbi yishmael: gag yesod lema li kera? kal vachomer hu: uma sheyare chattat, sheenah mechapperet – teuna gag yesod; techillat ola, shemmechapperet – eno din shetteuna gag yesod?!

Amar rabbi akiva: uma sheyare chattat, sheen mechapperin veen bain lechapper – teuna gag yesod; techillat ola, shemmechapperet uvaa lechapper – eno din shetteuna gag yesod?! im ken, ma talmud lomar "el yesod mizbach haola"? ten yesod (lammizbeach) [lemizbechah] shel ola.
May benayyhu? amar rav adda bar ahava: shirayim meakkevim ikka benayyhu – mar savar meakkevi, umar savar la meakkevi.
Rav pappa amar: dechulle alma – shirayim en meakkevim; vehacha bemitztzuy chattat haof meakkev ka mippalgi – mar savar meakkev, umar savar la meakkev.
Tanya kevavteh derav pappa: "veet kol haddam yishpoch" – ma talmud lomar "happar"? limmed al par yom hakkippurim, shettaun mattan damim laysod. divre rabbi.
Amar rabbi yishmael: kal vachomer; uma im mi sheen nichnas damo lifnim chova – taun yesod, mi shennichnas damo lifnim chova – eno din shettaun yesod?!
Amar rabbi akiva: uma mi sheen damo nichnas lifnay velifnim, ben lechova ben lemitzva – taun yesod, mi shennichnas damo chova lifnay velifnim – eno din shettaun yesod?!
Yachol yeakkevennu? talmud lomar: "vechilla mikkapper et hakkodesh" – shalmu kol hakkapparot kullan. divre rabbi yishmael.

Kal vachomer lefar kohen mashiach misseir nasi, meatta: uma mi sheen nichnas damo lifnim, lo chova vela mitzva – taun yesod, mi shennichnas damo lifnim ben lechova ben lemitzva – eno din shettaun yesod?!
Yachol yeakkevennu? talmud lomar: "veet kol (haddam) [dam happar] yishpoch" –
Nitteko hakkatuv laase, vaasao sheyare mitzva; lomar lecha: shirayim en meakkevin.
Vesavar rabbi yishmael: mitztzuy chattat haof meakkev?! vehatana deve rabbi yishmael: "vehannishar baddam yimmatze" – vehannishar yimmatze,
b: Vesheeno nishar lo yimmatze! tere tannae veallibba derabbi yishmael.
Amar rame bar chama, hay tanna savar: shirayim meakkevi. detanya: "hakkohen hamechatte otah" – otah shennittan damah lemala, velo otah shennittan damah lematta.

Amarta: vechi meayin bata? mikkelal shenneemar: "vedam zevachecha yishshafech al mizbach vegomer" – lamadnu lannittanin bemattan arba, sheim netanan bemattana achat – kipper. yachol af hannittanin lemala shennetanan lematta kipper?
Vedin hu – neemru damim lemala, veneemru damim lemattan; ma damim haamurim lemattan shennetanan lemalan – lo kipper, af damim haamurim lemalan – im natan lematta lo kipper!
Lo; im amarta battachtonim shennittanin bintina lemala sheen sofan lemalan – lo kipper; tomar baelyonim shennetanan lematta, sheyyesh mehen karev lematta?!
Damim (shirayim) happenimiyyim yochichu – sheyyesh mehen karev bachutz, veim netanan battechilla bachutz lo kipper!
Lo; im amarta bedamim happenimiyyim – sheen mizbeach happenimi memarkan; tomar beelyonim – shehare keranot memarkot otan; im netanan lematta – kesherim!
Talmud lomar: "otah" – otah shennittan damim lemala, velo shennittan damah lematta.
May sheen mizbeach happenimi memarkan? lav ellu shirayim?!
Amar leh rava: i hachi, tete bekal vachomer:
Ma shirayim happenimiyyim, shessofan chova bachutz – asaan battechilla bachutz lo kipper; hannittanin lemala, sheen sofan chova lematta, vaasaan battechilla lematta – eno din shello kipper?!
Ella en mizbeach happenimi memarkan bilvad, ella parochet.

Tanu rabbanan: "vechilla mikkapper" – im kipper killa, veim lo kipper la killa. divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi yehuda, mippene ma lo nomar: im killa kipper, im lo killa lo kipper? sheim chissar achat mikkol hammattanot – lo asa velo chelum.
May benayyhu? rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi; chad amar: mashmaut dorshin ikka benayyhu, vechad amar: shirayim meakkevin ikka benayyhu.
Tistayyem derabbi yehoshua ben levi hu deamar: shirayim dimakkevi; deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ledivre haomer shirayim meakkevin – mevi par echad, umatchil battechilla bifnim.
Attu rabbi yochanan let leh ha sevara?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: tanna rabbi nechemya kedivre haomer shirayim meakkevin!
Ella kedivre haomer – velav lehane tannae; hacha name, kedivre haomer – velav lehane tannae.

Mishna chattoot hatztzibbur vehayyachid – ellu hen chatteot hatztzibbur? seire rashe chodashim veshel moadot. shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon, vedaman taun arba mattanot al arba keranot. ketzad?

a: Ala bakkevesh ufana lassovev, uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit, mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit. sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod deromit, veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna bechol maachol, leyom valayla ad chatzot.
Gemara hechi aved? rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar; chad amar: noten amma elach veamma elach, vechad amar: mechatte veyored keneged chuddo shel keren.

Allibba derabbi elazar berabbi shimon, deamar: hi atzmah enah naaset ella begufah shel keren – dechulle alma la peligi; ki peligi – allibba derabbi. mar savar: amma elach veamma elach – keneged keren hu; umar savar: keneged chuddah in, tefe la.

Metivi: chattat hatztzibbur vehayyachid – ketzad mattan daman? haya ole lakkevesh ufana lassovev, uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit; vetovel beetzbao hayemanit – hameyummenet shebbayyamin – min haddam shebbammizrak; vechomer begudalo millemala uveetzbao ketanna millematta, umechatte veyored keneged chuddah shel keren, ad shemmechalle kol haddam shebbaetzba. vechen kol keren vakeren.
Hachi kaamar: mitzva bechuddah; i avad amma elach veamma elach – let lan ba.
May rabbi umay rabbi elazar berabbi shimon? detanya: damim haelyonim nittanin michut hassikra ulemala, damim hattachtonim nittanin michut hassikra ulemattan. divre rabbi.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: bamme devarim amurin – beolat haof, aval bechattat behema – hi atzmah en naaset ella al gufah shel keren.

Amar rabbi avahu: may tama derabbi? dichtiv: "vehaharel arba ammot, umehaharel ulemala vegomer". arba ammot hu dehavya?! amar rav adda bar ahava: umekom keranot arba. mekom keranot arba havya?! ella ema: reshut keranot arba.

Tenan hatam: chut shel sikra chogro baemtza, lehavedil ben damim haelyonim ledamim hattachtonim. mena hane mille? amar rav acha bar rav kattina, shenneemar: "vehayta hareshet ad chatzi hammizbeach" – hattora natna mechitza lehavedil ben damim haelyonim ledamim hattachtonim.
Sheyare haddam kulei. tanu rabbanan: "el yesod mizbeach" – ze yesod deromi. atta omer ze yesod deromi; o eno ella yesod maaravi,
Veyilmad satum min hameforash? amarta: yilmad yeridato min hakkevesh litziato min hahechol; ma yetziato min hahechol – besamuch lo, af yeridato min hakkevesh – besamuch lo.
Tanya, rabbi yishmael omer: ze vaze yesod maaravi. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: ze vaze yesod deromi.
Bishlama leman deamar yesod maaravi – kasavar: yilmad satum min hameforash.
Ella leman deamar yesod deromi, may tama? amar rabbi assi, kasavar hay tanna: kulleh mizbeach betzafon kae. lishshana acharina: kulleh petach bedarom kae.
b: Tana deve rabbi yishmael kerabbi shimon ben yochay omrim: ze vaze yesod maaravi. vesimanech: mashchu gavre legavra.
Mishna haola kodshe kadashim, shechitatah batztzafon, vekibbul damah bichle sharet batztzafon, vedamah taun shete mattanot shehen arba, uteuna hefshet venittuach, vechalil laishshim.
Gemara ola may tama tane leh kodshe kadashim? mishshum dela ketiv ba "(laAdonai) kodshe kadashim hi".
Vedamah taun shete mattanot. hechi aved? amar rav: noten vechozer venoten. ushemuel amar: mattana achat kemin gamma noten.
Ketannae – yachol yizrekennu zerika achat? talmud lomar: "saviv". i saviv, yachol yakkifennu kechut? talmud lomar: "vezarku". ha ketzad? kemin gamma – vedamah taun shete mattanot shehen arba.
Rabbi yishmael omer: neemar kan "saviv", veneemar lehallan "saviv"; ma lehallan – pissuk vearba mattanot, af kan – pissuk vearba mattanot.
I – ma lehallan arba mattanot al arba keranot, af kan arba mattanot al arba keranot?! amarta: ola teuna yesod; vekeren mizrachit deromit lo haya lah yesod.
May tama? amar rabbi elazar: lefi shello hayta bechelko shel toref. deamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: mizbeach ochel bechelko shel yehuda amma.

Amar rabbi levi bar chama amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: retzua hayta yotza mechelko shel yehuda venichneset bechelko shel binyamin, vehaya binyamin hatztzaddik mitztaer aleha bechol yom lenotlah, shenneemar:

a: "Chofef alav kol hayyom". lefichach zacha binyamin hatztzaddik venaasa ushepizchan lehakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "uven ketefav shachen".
Metivi: olat haof ketzad hayta naaset? haya molek et roshah mimmul orpah, umavdil, umematztze damah al kir hammizbeach.
Vei amrat lo haya lah yesod – beavvera bealma hu deka aved! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: emar kach hitnu – avvera devinyamin, karka dihuda.
May lo (hava) [haya] lah yesod? rav amar: bevinyan, levi amar: bedamim. rav metargem: "beachsanteh yitbene madbecha", levi metargem: "beachsanteh yitbene makdesha" – mekom mekuddash ledamim.
Ta shema: hayesod haya mehallech al pene kol hatztzafon veal pene kol hammaarav, ochel baddarom amma achat uvammizrach amma achat! may "ochel" name – bedamim.
Ta shema: hammizbeach haya sheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim! hacha bemay askinan – min hatztzad.
Ta shema: nimtza poreach amma al yesod veamma al sovev! ema keneged amma yesod, veal amma sovev.

Ta shema, detane levi: ketzad bonin et hammizbeach? meviin malben shehu sheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim vegovho amma, umevi chaluke avanim mefullamot – ben gedolot ben ketannot, umevi sid vekuneya vazefet, umemache veshofech. veze hu mekom yesod.

Vechozer umevi malben shehu sheloshim amma al sheloshim amma vegovho chamesh ammot, umevi chaluke avanim kulei. vechozer umevi malben shehu esrim ushemone al esrim ushemone ammot vegovho shalosh ammot, umevi chaluke kulei. vehu mekom hammaaracha.
Vechozer umevi malben shehu amma al amma, umevi chaluke avanim mefullamot ben gedolot ben ketannot, umevi zefet vekuneya, umemache veshofech. vezehu keren. vechen lechol keren vakeren.
Vechi tema
b: Degayez leh, "avanim shelemot" ketiv!

Demachet midde mittuteh, veshakel leh. dei la tema hachi, ha deamar rav kahana: avanim shel keranot chalulot hayu – dichtiv: "umalu kammizrak kezaviyyot mizbeach"; hacha name "avanim shelemot" amar rachamana! ella demachet midde mittuteh veshakel leh; hacha name, demachet midde mittuteh veshakel leh.
Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "vayyelech david ushemuel vayyeshvu benoyot barama"? vechi ma inyan noyot etzel rama? ella shehayu yoshvin barama veoskin benoyo shel olam.
Amri, ketiv: "vekamta vealita el hammakom" – melammed shebbet hammikdash gavoah mikkol eretz yisrael, veeretz yisrael gevoha mikkol aratzot. la havo yadi ducheteh hecha;
Ayyto sefer yehoshua, bechullehu ketiv: "veyarad (veala) haggevul", "vetaar haggevul"; beshevet binyamin "veala" ketiv, "veyarad" la ketiv. amri, shema minna: hacha hu mekomo.
Sevur lemivneyeh been etam – demiddele; amri: nitatte beh kallil, kedichtiv: "uven ketefav shachen".
Veibbaet ema: gemiri desanhedrin bechelko dihuda ushechina bechelko devinyamin, vei medallinan leh – mitpeleg tuva; mutav denitatte beh pureta, kedichtiv: "uven ketefav shachen".

Veal davar ze nitkanne doeg haadomi bedavid, kedichtiv: "ki kinat betcha achalatni", uchetiv: "zechor Adonai ledavid et kol unnoto asher nishba laAdonai vegomer, im avo beohel beti vegomer, im etten shenat leenay leafappay tenuma ad emtza makom laAdonai vegomer".
"Hinne shemaanuha veefrata metzanuha bisde yaar"; "beefrata" – ze yehoshua, dekaate meefrayim. "metzanuha bisde yaar" – ze binyamin, dichtiv: "binyamin zeev yitraf".
Mishna zivche shalme tzibbur vaashamot; ellu hen ashamot – asham gezelot, asham meilot, asham shifcha charufa, asham nazir, asham metzora, asham taluy;

Shechitatan batztzafon vekibbul daman bichle sharet batztzafon, vedaman taun shete mattanot shehen arba, veneechalin lifnim min hakkelaim – lezichre chehunna, lechol maachol, leyom valayla ad chatzot.

a: Gemara mena lan devae tzafon? detane rabba bar rav chanan kammeh derava: "vaasitem seir izzim echad lechattat" – ma chattat batztzafon, af shalme tzibbur batztzafon.
Amar leh rava: vechi chattat mehechan lamda – meola; davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh?!

Ella middetane rav mari bereh derav kahana: "al olotechem veal zivche shalmechem" – ma ola kodshe kadashim, af zivche shalme tzibbur kodshe kadashim; ma ola batztzafon, af zivche shalme tzibbur batztzafon.
Ella hekkesha kamma lemay ata? ki chattat – ma chattat enah neechelet ella lezichre chehunna, af zivche shalme tzibbur lezichre chehunna.

Amar leh abbaye: i hachi, gabbe el nazir dichtiv: "vehikriv et korbano laAdonai keves ben shenato tamim echad leola, vechavsa achat bat shenatah [temima] lechattat, veayil echad [tamim] lishlamim" – hachi name nema dehikkish hakkatuv lechattat: ma chattat enah neechelet ella lezichre chehunna, af el nazir name eno neechol ella lezichre chehunna?!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam, kevan dichtiv "velakach hakkohen et hazzeroa beshela min haayil" – mikkelal dechulleh bealim achli leh.
Zeroa beshela miha la litachil ella lezichre chehunna! kashya.
Veibbaet ema: kodshe ikkeri, kodshe kodashim la ikkeru. veella lemay hilcheta ittakkash? amar rava: sheim gillach al echad mishsheloshtan – yatza.

Mishna hattoda veel nazir, kadashim kallim, shechitatan bechol makom baazara, vedaman taun shete mattanot shehen arba, veneechalin bechol hair, lechol adam, bechol maachol, leyom valayla ad chatzot. hammuram mehem keyotze bahen, ella shehammuram neechol lakkohanim, linshehem velivnehem uleavdehem.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "et chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma tochlu bemakom tahor" – amar rabbi nechemya: vechi rishonim betumea achalum?!
Ella tahor – mikkelal shehu tame; tahor mittumeat metzora, vetame mittumeat zav. veeze ze? ze machane yisrael.
Veema tahor mittumeat zav vetame mittumeat met – veeze ze, ze machane leviyya!
Amar abbaye, amar kera: "vaachaltem otah bemakom kadosh" – otah bemakom kadosh velo acheret bemakom kadosh, appeka lemachane leviyya; hadar ketiv: "bemakom tahor" – appeka lemachane yisrael.
Rava amar: "otah bemakom kadosh" – velo acheret bemakom kadosh, appeka ligmare. hadar ketav rachamana: "tochlu bimkom tahor" – ayyla lemachane yisrael.
Veema ayyeyla lemachane leviyya! lachada meayyeylinan, letarte la meayyeylinan.
I hachi, appoke name – lachada mappekinan, letarte la mappekinan! veod, "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha" ketiv! ella mechavvavrta kidabbaye.

Mishna shelamim – kadashim kallim – shechitatan bechol makom baazara, vedaman taun shete mattanot shehen arba, veneechalin bechol hair, lechol adam, bechol maachol, lishne yamim velayla echad; hammuram mehem kayyotze bahem, ella shehammuram neechol lakkohanim, linshehem, velivnehem, uleavdehem.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "ushechato petach ohel moed"; "veshachat oto lifne ohel moed"; "veshachat oto lifne ohel moed" –

Lehacheshir et kol haruchot bekadashim kallim. kal vachomer latztzafon: uma kodshe kodashim, shello hucheshru bechol haruchot – hucheshru batztzafon; kadashim kallim, shehucheshru bechol haruchot – eno din shehucheshru batztzafon?!

Rabbi eliezer omer: lo neemar hakkatuv ella lehacheshir tzafon; sheyyachol vahalo din hu: uma kadashim kallim, shehucheshru bechol haruchot – lo hucheshar mekoman etzel kodshe kadashim; kodshe kodashim, shello hucheshru ella batztzafon – eno din shello hucheshar mekoman etzel kadashim kallim?! talmud lomar: "ohel moed".
b: Bemay ka mippalgi? tanna kamma savar: telata kerae ketivi; chad legufeh – denive petach ohel moed, vechad lehacheshir tzedadin, vechad lifsol tzidde tzedadin. vetzafon la itzterich kera.
Verabbi eliezer savar: chad legufeh – denive petach ohel moed, vechad lehacheshir tzafon, vechad lehacheshir tzedadin. vetzidde tzedadin la itzterich kera.

May shena hacha – dichtiv: "petach ohel moed", umay shena hatam – dichtiv: "lifne ohel moed"? ka mashma lan kidrav yehuda amar shemuel; deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shelamim sheshshechatan kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechol – pesulin, shenneemar: "ushechato petach ohel moed" – bizman shehu patuach, velo bizman shehu naul.

Ittemar name, amar mar ukeva bar chama amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: shelamim sheshshechatan kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechol – pesulin, shenneemar: "ushechato petach ohel moed" – bizman sheppetach hahechol patuach, velo bizman shehu naul.

Bemareva matne hachi – amar rav yaakov bar acha amar rav ashe: shelamim sheshshechatan kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechol – pesulim. uvammishkan – kodem sheyyaamidu leviyyim et hammishkan, uleachar sheyyefarku leviyyim et hammishkan – pesulim.
Peshita – mugaf, kenaul dame. vilon may? amar rabbi zera: hu atzmo en naase ella kefetach patuach.

Guveha may? ta shema: detanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: shene pishpashin hayu bevet hachalifot, vegovhan shemona; kede lehacheshir et haazara kullah laachilat kodshe kadashim, velishchitat kadashim kallim.
May, lav deikka kammayyhu shemone? la; degavhu ninhu shemone.
Metivi: kol hashshearim shehayu sham – govhan esrim amma, verochban eser amma! pishpashin shane.
Vehaikka tzedadin! dimayyel lehu bekeren zavit.

Achore bet hakkapporet may? ta shema, deamar rame bar rav yehuda amar rav: lul katan haya achore bet hakkapporet, gavoah shemone ammot; kede lehacheshir et haazara laachilat kodshe kadashim, velishchitat kadashim kallim. vehayeynu dichtiv: "shenayim lapparbar". may "lapparbar"? amar rabba bar rav shela, keman deamar: kelappe bar.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en chayyayvin mishshum tumea, ella al

a: Orech mea ushemonim vasheva al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh.

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: kol haazara hayta mea shemonim vasheva al rochav mea sheloshim vechamesh. amar leh, hachi amar li abba: kegon ze – kohanim nichnasin lesham veochlin sham kodshe kadashim, veshochatin sham kadashim kallim, vechayyayvin mishshum tumea.
Lemaote may? illema lemaote challonot, delatot veovi hachoma – tenena: hachallonot veovi hachoma kelifnim!
Veella lemaote leshachot? vei benuyot bachol ufetuchot lakkodesh – vehatnan: tochan kodesh! midderabbanan.

Udeorayyta la?! vehatanya: leshachot benuyot bachol, ufetuchot lakkodesh. minnayin shehakkohanim nichnasin lesham veochlim sham kodshe kadashim usheyare mincha? talmud lomar: "bachatzar ohel moed yochluha" – hattora ribbeta chatzerot harebe etzel achila achat.
Amar rava: laachila shane.

Aval leinyan tumea la?! vehatanya: leshachot habbenuyot lachol ufetuchot lakkodesh – kohanim nichnasin lesham veochlin sham kodshe kadashim, veen shochatin sham kadashim kallim, vechayyayvin mishshum tumea!
Lav amrat "en shochatin"? teni name "en chayyayvin".
Bishlama en shochatin – baena keneged happetach, velekka; ella en chayyayvin – ammay?

Velitamaych, en shochatin – mi la askinan deikka shechita keneged happetach?! dei lekka, lemay itzterich? ella af al gav deka shachet keneged happetach – teni "en shochatin" mishshum dela kadesh; teni name: "en chayyayvin".

Velaachila la baenan keneged happetach?! vehatanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: shene pishpashin hayu bevet hachalifot, govhan shemone; kede lehacheshir et haazara laachilat kodshe kadashim, velishchitat kadashim kallim! amar ravina: semi mikkan achila.
Vehachtiv: "bashshelu et habbasar petach ohel moed, vesham tochlu oto"! kodshe shaa shane.

Amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi: minnayin ledam – shennifsal bishkiat hachamma? shenneemar: "bayyom hakerivo et zivcho yeachel" – beyom sheatta zoveach atta makriv, beyom shei atta zoveach i atta makriv.
Hay mibbee leh
b: Legufeh! im ken, nema kera: "beyom zivcho yeachel"; "hakerivo" lema li? shema minna: beyom sheatta zoveach atta makriv, beyom shei atta zoveach i atta makriv.

Vedilma hachi kaamar rachamana: i karev dam haiddana – nitachel basar haiddana velimchar, i karev dam limchar – nitachel basar limchar uleyoma uchera? im ken, nema kera: "beyom hakerivo yochal"; "zivcho" lema li? shema minna: beyom sheatta zoveach atta makrivo, beyom shei atta zoveach i atta makrivo.
Ittemar: hamechashshev leor shelishi – chizkiyya amar: kasher, rabbi yochanan amar: pasul. chizkiyya amar kasher – deha la innetik lisrefa; rabbi yochanan amar pasul – deha iddechi leh meachila.
Haochel leor shelishi – chizkiyya amar: patur, dela innetik lisrefa; rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, deha iddechi leh meachila.

Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: kadashim hanneechalin leyom echad – mechashshevin bedaman mishshettishka hachamma, uvivsaran uveemurehen mishsheyyaale ammud hashshachar. kadashim hanneechalin lishne yamim velayla achat – mechashshevin bedaman mishshettishka hachamma, uveemurehen mishsheyyaale ammud hashshachar, uvivsaran mishshettishka hachamma shel shene yamim.

Tanu rabbanan: yachol yehu neechalin leor shelishi? vedin hu – zevachim neechalin leyom echad, uzevachim neechalin lishne yamim; ma zevachim hanneechalin leyom echad – layla acharehen, af zevachim hanneechalin lishne yamim – layla acharehen.
Talmud lomar: "vehannotar ad yom" – beod yom hu neechol, veeno neechol leor shelishi.

Yachol yissaref miyyad? vedin hu – zevachim neechalin leyom echad, uzevachim neechalin lishne yamim; ma zevachim hanneechalin leyom echad – techef laachila serefa, af zevachim hanneechalin lishne yamim – techef laachila serefa.
Talmud lomar: "bayyom hashshelishi baesh yissaref" – bayyom atta sorfo, vei atta sorfo ballayla.
Mishna habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach – kadashim kallim – shechitatan bechol makom baazara; vedaman taun mattana echat, uvilvad sheyyitten keneged hayesod.

Shinna baachilatan. habbechor – neechol lakkohanim, vehammaaser – lechol adam; veneechalin bechol hair, bechol maachol, lishne yamim velayla echad. happesach – eno neechol ella ballayla, veeno neechol ella ad chatzot, veeno neechol ella limnuyav, veeno neechol ella tzali.

Gemara man tanna? amar rav chisda: rabbi yose haggelili hi. detanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: "chelbo" lo neemar ella "chelbam"; "damo" lo neemar ella "damam"; limmed al bechor umaaser ufesach, shetteunin mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach.
Keneged hayesod mena lan? amar rabbi eliezer: atya "zerika"–"zerika" meola.

a: Veola gufa menalan? dichtiv: "el yesod mizbach haola" – limmed al olat chova shetteuna yesod.
I – ma lehallan shete mattanot shehen arba, af kan shete mattanot shehen arba?!
Amar abbaye: lema li lemichtav "saviv" beola, "saviv" bechattat? havu shene ketuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin may ikka lememar? have asham shelosha, ushelosha vadday en melammedin.

Habbechor neechol lakkohanim. tanu rabbanan: minnayin labbechor shenneechol lishne yamim velayla? shenneemar: "uvesaram yihye lach kachaze hattenufa ucheshok hayyamin" – hikkisho hakkatuv lechaze vashok shel shelamim; ma shelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayla echad, af bechor neechol lishne yamim velayla echad.
Vezo sheela nishala lifne chachamim bakkerem beyavne: bechor lechamma neechol? naana rabbi tarfon veamar: lishne yamim velayla echad.

Haya sham talmid echad shebba levet hammidrash lifne chachamim techilla, verabbi yose haggelili shemo, amar lo: rabbi, minnayin lach? amar lo: beni, shelamim kadashim kallim, uvechor kadashim kallim; ma shelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayla echad, af bechor neechol lishne yamim velayla echad.
Amar lo: rabbi, bechor mattana lakkohen, vechattat veasham mattana lakkohen; ma chattat veasham leyom valayla, af bechor leyom valayla!

Amar lo: nadun davar mittoch davar, venilmad davar mittoch davar; ma shelamim en bain al chet – af bechor eno ba al chet, ma shelamim neechalim lishne yamim velayla echad – af bechor neechol lishne yamim velayla echad.

Amar lo: rabbi, nadun davar middavar, yilmad davar middavar; chattat veasham mattana lakkohen, uvechor mattana lakkohen; ma chattat veasham en bain beneder unedava – af bechor eno beneder unedava, ma chattat veasham neechalin leyom echad – af bechor neechol leyom echad!

Kafatz rabbi akiva, venistallek rabbi tarfon. amar lo: hare hu omer "uvesaram yihye lach" – hikkishan hakkatuv lechaze vashok shel shelamim; ma shelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayla echad, af bechor neechol lishne yamim velayla echad.
Amar lo: hikkashto lechaze vashok shel shelamim, vaani makkisho lechaze vashok shel toda – ma toda neechelet leyom velayla, af bechor neechol leyom velayla!
Amar lo: hare hu omer: "uvesaram yihye lach" – sheen talmud lomar "lecha yihye", uma talmud lomar "lecha yihye"? hosif hakkatuv havaya acheret babbechor.

Ucheshennemeru devarim lifne rabbi yishmael, amar lahen: tzeu veimru lo lerabbi akiva: taita. toda mehechan lamda – mishshelamim; [vechi] davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh?! ha en alecha liddon belashon acharon, ella belashon rishon.
Verabbi yishmael, hay "lecha yihye" may aved leh? limmed al bechor baal mum shehu mattana lakkohen – shello matzinu bechol hattora.
Verabbi akiva yalef leh mibbesaram" – chad tam vechad baal mum. verabbi yishmael, mibbesaram" dehanach bechorot kaamar.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: hemennu vedavar acher – have hekkesh; umar savar: la have hekkesh.
Bishlama leman deamar la have hekkesh, hayeynu dichtiv: "vechen yaase leohel moed" –
Keshem shemmazze lifnay velifnim achat lemala vesheva lematta middam happar, kach mazze bahechol.
Ucheshem shellifnay velifnim achat lemala vesheva lematta middam hassair, kach mazze bahechol.
Ella leman deamar have hekkesh, may ikka lememar? mekomot hu degamri mehadade.
b: Veibbaet ema: chutz mippenim bechad zimna gemir.
Bishlama leman deamar [la] have hekkesh, hayeynu dichtiv: "mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa" –
Sheen talmud lomar "taviu", ma talmud lomar "taviu"? kol sheatta mevi mimmakom (lemakom) acher hare hu kaze; ma lehallan issaron lechalla, af kan issaron lechalla.
I – ma lehallan shene esronim, af kan shene esronim?! talmud lomar: "tihyena".
Velamadnu asara lechametz; asara lematztza minnayin? talmud lomar "al challot lechem chametz" – neged chametz have matztza.
Ella leman deamar (la) have hekkesh, may ikka lememar? "taviu" – yattira hi.

Happesach eno neechol. man tanna? amar rav yosef: rabbi elazar ben azarya hi. detanya, rabbi elazar [ben azarya] omer: neemar kan "ballayla [hazze]", veneemar lehallan: "veavarti veeretz mitzrayim ballayla hazze";
Ma lehallan ad chatzot, af kan ad chatzot.
Amar lo rabbi akiva, vahalo kevar neemar: "vaachaltem oto bechippazon" – ad sheat chippazon!
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "ballayla hazze"? sheyyachol yehe kechol hakkodashim hanneechalim bayyom; talmud lomar "ballayla" – ballayla yehe neechol, veeno neechol bayyom.
Amar leh abbaye: umimmay derabbi elazar ben azarya, udeorayyta? dilma derabbanan, uleharchik min haavera! im ken, may "ella ad chatzot"? ella ki hatam – ma hatam deorayyta, af kan name deorayyta.
Hadaran alach ezehu mekoman

a: Mishna kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan berosh hammizbeach – rabbi yose omer: keillu nishchatu batztzafon. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: mechatzi hammizbeach veladdarom – kaddarom, mechatzi hammizbeach velatztzafon – katztzafon.
Gemara amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: omer haya Rabbi yose, kulleh mizbeach betzafon kae. umay "keillu"? mahu detema baenan "al yarech" – velekka; ka mashma lan.
Amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi: ella meatta, lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda – hachi name dechetzyo betzafon vechetzyo baddarom?!
Vechi tema hachi name; veha at hu deamrat mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: mode rabbi yose berabbi yehuda sheim shechatan kenegdan bakkarka – pesula!
Amar leh: hachi kaamar rabbi yochanan – shenehem mikra echad darshu: "vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha" –
Rabbi yose savar: kullo leola vechullo lishlamim. verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar: chetzyo leola vechetzyo lishlamim;
Dei salka datach kullo leola kasher, hasheta kullo leola – kasher, kullo lishlamim mibbaya?!
Veiddach – itzterich; salka datach amena: ola hu didchik leh makom; aval shelamim, dela dechik leh makom – ema la; ka mashma lan.

Gufa – amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: mode rabbi yose berabbi yehuda sheim shechatan kenegdan bakkarka – pesulot. amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: may kenegdan bakkarka? ilema amma yesod amma sovev – hay gufeh mizbeach hu! veod, may "kenegdan bakkarka"?

Vechi tema deaved mechillot bakkarka veshachet behu – vechi hay gavvna mi have mizbeach?! vehatanya: "mizbach adama taase li" – sheyyehe mechubbar (meadama) [baadama]; shello yivnennu lo al gabbe mechillot velo al gabbe kippin.
La tzericha, devatztzereh batztzore.
Amar rabbi zera: efshar ita leha derabbi yochanan, vela tenena la bematnitin?!

Nefak, dak veashkach – ditnan: berru mishsham atze teena yafim lesadder maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret; keneged keren maaravit deromit, mashuch min hakkeren kelappe tzafon arba ammot; beomed chamesh sein gechalim. uveshabbat – beomed shemone sein gechalim, sheshsham hayu notnin shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim.
Umay simana? rabbi yose hi, detanya,
b: Rabbi yose omer: ze siman – kol hannittal bifnim linnaten bachutz, eno noten ella besamuch sheen lifnim;
Vechol hannittal bachutz linnaten lifnim, eno nittal ella besamuch sheen lifnim.
Kol hannittal bifnim linnaten bachutz – may nihu? illema shirayim, behedya ketiv behu: "el yesod mizbach haola asher petach ohel moed"!
Vetu, kol hannittal bachutz linnaten bifnim – may nihu? illema gechalim shel yom hakkippurim, behedya ketiv behu: "velakach melo hammachta gachale esh vegomer"!
Ella kol hannittal bifnim linnaten bachutz – shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim, degamri mishshirayim.
Hannittal bachutz linnaten bifnim – gechalim dechol yoma veyoma, degamran miggechalim shel yom hakkippurim.
Umay kasavar? i kasavar kulleh mizbeach bedarom kae, esrim vesheva bae lemete!
Vei name kasavar kedushshat hechol veulam chada hi, esrim vetarte bae mete!
Vei kasavar chetzyo batztzafon vechetzyo baddarom, chad sere bae lemete! veella kasavar kedushshat hechol veulam chada milleta hi? shet bae lemete!
Ella lav mishshum dekasavar kulleh mizbeach betzafon kae?
Vehane arba ammot – amma yesod, veamma sovev, veamma makom keranot, veamma mekom ragle hakkohanim; dechi mesaggu lekammeh tefe – tu lekka petach.

Amar rav adda bar ahava: ha manni – rabbi yehuda hi. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: mizbeach memutztza veomed beemtza haazara; vshloshim ushetayim ammot hayu lo – eser ammot keneged pitcho shel hechol, achat esre amma mikkan, veachat esre amma mikkan; nimtza mizbeach mechvvavn keneged hechol.
Sof sof, lerabbi yehuda chad sere bae lemete; vei kasavar kedushshat hechol veulam chada milleta hi, shet bae lemete!
Mi savrat hane arba ammot – bahade amma yesod veamma sovev?! arba ammot bar meamma yesod veamma sovev.
Venokma kerabbi yose, uvimmutztza! mishshum derabbi yehuda shemana leh memutztza behedya.
Verav sherevya amar: ha manni – rabbi yose haggelili hi. detanya: rabbi yose haggelili omer, mittoch shenneemar: "venatatta et hakkiyyor ben ohel moed" vegomer, "veet

a: Mizbach haola vegomer" – mizbeach befetach ohel moed, velo kiyyor befetach ohel moed. hechan haya notno? ben haulam velammizbeach, mashuch kima kelappe haddarom.
May kasavar? i kasavar kulleh mizbeach bedarom kae – nokmeh mikkotel hechol veladdarom, ben ulam lammizbeach!
Vei name kasavar kedushshat hechol veulam chada hi – nokmeh mikkotel ulam veladdarom, beven ulam lammizbeach!
I name kasavar chetzyo batztzafon vechetzyo baddarom – nokmeh mikkotel hechol veladdarom, ben ulam velammizbeach!
Vei name kasavar kedushshat haulam vehechol chada hi – nokmeh mikkotel ulam veladdarom, ben ulam velammizbeach! ella lav mishshum dekasavar kulleh mizbeach batztzafon?
Ki name mokmat la mikkotel hechol velatztzafon – have leh ben ulam velammizbeach;
Venokma mikkotel ulam velatztzafon, beven ulam velammizbeach!
Amar kera: "tzafona" – sheyyehe tzafon panuy mikkelim.
Man tanna diflig aleh derabbi yose haggelili? rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi. detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: "tzafona" – sheyyehe tzafon panuy mikkelum, vaafillu min hammizbeach.

Amar rav: mizbeach shennifgam – kol hakkodashim shennishchatu sham pesulin. mikra hu beyadenu, ushechachnuhu. ki selek rav kahana, ashkecheh lerabbi shimon berabbi dekaamar mishshum rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: minnayin lammizbeach shennifgam – shekkol hakkodashim shennishchatu sham pesulin?
Shenneemar: "vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha" – vechi alav atta zoveach?! ella keshehu shalem, velo keshehu chaser. amar: hayeynu kera deishtemit leh lerav.
Verabbi yochanan amar: echad ze veechad ze pesulin. bemay peligi? rav savar: baale chayyim enan nidchim, verabbi yochanan savar: baale chayyim nidchin.
Metivi: kol hakkodashim shehayu ad shello nivna hammizbeach, veachar kach nivna hammizbeach – pesulin. nivna?! dechuyin meikkara ninhu!
Ella ad shello neheras hammizbeach. neheras?! ha izzekun lehu!
Ella ad shello nifgam hammizbeach, veachar kach nifgam hammizbeach – pesulin. vela tarotze ka metartzat? ema: shennishchatu.
Vehaamar rav giddel amar rav: mizbeach shenneekar – maktirin ketoret bimkomo!
Kidamar rava: mode haya rabbi yehuda bedamim; hacha name – mode rav bedamim.
May rabbi yehuda? detanya: "bayyom hahu kiddash hammelech toch hechatzer vegomer, ki mizbeach (sheasa moshe) katan mehachil" – devarim kichtavan. divre rabbi yehuda.
Amar lo rabbi yose,
b: Vahalo kevar neemar: "elef olot yaale shelomo al hammizbeach hahu", veillu bevet olamim hu omer: "vayyizbach shelomo et zevach hashshelamim asher zavach laAdonai bakar esrim ushenayim elef";
Uchesheatta maggia lecheshbon olot uleminyan ammot – ze gadol mizze!
Ella mahu "katan mehachil", keadam haomer lachavero: "peloni nannas hu" – ufasul laavoda.

Verabbi yehuda – shappir kaamar rabbi yose! rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: mizbeach sheasa moshe – gadol haya. detanya: "chamesh ammot orech vechamesh ammot rochav" – devarim kichtavan. divre rabbi yose.
Rabbi yehuda omer: neemar kan "ravua", veneemar lehallan "ravua"; ma lehallan meemtzaito haya moded, af kan meemtzaito haya moded.
Vehatam menalan? dichtiv: "vehaariel shetem esre amma lechol ruach". o eno ella shetem esre al shetem esre? keshehu omer: "al arbaat revaav" – melammed shemmeemtza hu moded.
Verabbi yose, ki gemir gezera shava – begovhah hu digmir. detanya: "veshalosh ammot komato" – devarim kichtavan. divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yose omer: neemar kan "ravua", veneemar lehallan "ravua"; ma lehallan – govho pi shenayim keorko, af kan – pi shenayim keorko.
Amar leh rabbi yehuda, vahalo kevar neemar: "veet hechatzer mea amma vekoma chamesh ammot vegomer" – efshar kohen omed al gabbe hammizbeach vaavoda beyado, vechol haam roin oto mibbachutz?!

Amar lo rabbi yose, vahalo kevar neemar: "veet kale hechatzer veet masach shaar hechatzer asher al hammishkan veal hammizbeach" – ma mishkan eser ammot, af mizbeach eser ammot; veomer: "kelaim chamesh esre

a: Amma el hakkatef". uma talmud lomar "chamesh ammot"? missefat mizbeach ulemala.
Uma talmud lomar "veshalosh ammot komato"? missefat sovev ulemala.
Verabbi yehuda, ki gemir gezera shava – berachbah hu digmir.
Ulerabbi yehuda, ha ka mitchaze kohen! nehi dechohen mitchaze; avoda divyado – la mitchaze.
Bishlama lerabbi yehuda, hayeynu dichtiv "kiddesh"; ella lerabbi yose, may "kiddesh"? lehaamid bah mizbeach.
Bishlama lerabbi yose, hayeynu dichtiv "katan"; ella lerabbi yehuda, may "katan"? hachi kaamar: mizbach avanim sheasa shelomo tachat mizbach hannechoshet – katan hava.
Bemay peligi? mar savar: danin chutz michutz, veen danin chutz mippenim;
Umar savar: danin keli mikkeli, veen danin keli mibbinyan.

Amar rava: mode rabbi yehuda bedamim. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: kos echad haya memalle middam hattaarovot, veshofcho al gabbe mizbeach; sheim yishshafech damo shel achat mehen – nimtza ze machshiro.
Vei salka datach savar rabbi yehuda kulla azara mikkaddesha – ha itavida leh mitzvevteh!
Vedilma mishshum dekasavar sheficha mikkoach haadam baenan? im ken, nishkeleh venishpoych leh adducheteh!
Vedilma mishshum devaenan mitzva min hammuvechar?

Amar rabbi elazar: mizbeach shennifgam – en ochlim begino sheyare mincha, shenneemar: "veichluha matztzot etzel hammizbeach" – vechi etzel hammizbeach achaluha?! ella bizman shehu shalem, velo bizman shehu chaser.
Ashkechan sheyare mincha, kodshe kodashim menalan? talmud lomar: "kodesh kadashim".
Kadashim kallim minnayin? amar abbaye: atya midderasha derabbi yose, detanya: rabbi yose omer shelosha devarim mishshum
b: Shelosha zekenim, veze echad mehen: rabbi yishmael omer, yachol yaale adam maaser sheni lirushalayim veyochlennu bizman hazze? vedin hu – bechor taun havaat makom, umaaser taun havaat makom; ma bechor – eno ella bifne habbayit, af maaser – eno ella bifne habbayit.
Ma livchor, shekken taun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach!
Bikkurim yochichu. ma levikkurim, shekken teunin hannacha!
Talmud lomar: "vahavetem shamma olotechem vegomer" – makkish maaser livchor; ma bechor – eno ella bifne habbayit, af maaser – eno ella bifne habbayit.
Venihdar dina, venete bema hatztzad"!
Mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken yesh bahen tzad mizbeach.
May kasavar? i kasavar kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo – afillu bechor name! vei kasavar lo kiddesha leatid lavo – afillu bechor name tive!
Amar ravina: leolam kasavar lo kiddesha; vehacha bemay askinan – bivchor shennizrak damo kodem chureban habbayit, vecharav habbayit, vaadayin besaro kayyaym.
Veittakkash besaro ledamo; ma damo bammizbeach, af besaro bammizbeach; veate maaser veyalef mibbechor.
Vechi davar hallamed behekkesh, chozer umelammed behekkesh?! masar dagan chullin hu.
Hanicha leman deamar batar lamed azlinan; ella leman deamar batar melammed azlinan – may ikka lememar?
Dam uvasar chada milleta hi.

Ki selek ravin, amra lishmata kammeh derabbi yirmeya. amar: bavlae tafshae – ammetul deyatvi beara chashocha, amri shemata dimchashshecha! la shemia lehu ha detanya: bishat silluk massaot – kadashim nifsalin, vezavim umetzoraim mishtallechim chutz lammechitza;
Vetanya iddach: bishne mekomot kodashim neechalim. may, lav ha bekodshe kadashim, ha bekadashim kallim?
